purpose: Teach: 存分/思いつか/おそらくは/久し振り/こんばんわ/すっごい/言い聞かせ/戸惑い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お休みの日は存分に遊んでいいのよ
lines.en: Sho, you can play as much as you'd like on your day off.
lines.style: Warm, permissive tone. Gentle opening, like she's giving him permission to fully relax. Soft pace, encouraging. The voice of someone who understands he needs to hear this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、おやつ何を食べるか思いつかないよ
lines.en: Mom, I can't decide what snack I want.
lines.style: Small, uncertain voice. Not whining — genuinely stuck. Slight upward lift at the end like he's asking for help. The quietness of someone who thinks before he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはおそらくは7時に帰ってくるわね
lines.en: Your father will probably be home around seven, won't he?
lines.style: Practical, gentle. Slightly distant quality — thinking aloud while managing the day. Steady pace, like she's checking herself against a mental schedule. Not directed at him, but shared with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんに久し振りに会えたよ
lines.en: Sho, you got to see Grandpa after so long.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Picking up on his unspoken joy. Soft, affirming tone. A pause before his name — like she's genuinely pleased for him. Not asking, observing with tenderness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんに「こんばんわ」って挨拶してね
lines.en: Make sure to say good evening to Grandma, okay?
lines.style: Clear, gentle instruction. Not demanding — guiding. A light touch of expectation, the way a mother reminds without commanding. Warm undertone, like she trusts he'll do it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お庭のお花、すっごい綺麗だったよ
lines.en: The flowers in the garden were really beautiful, weren't they?
lines.style: Affirming, following his lead. Mirroring his wonder without diminishing it. Soft, genuinely interested tone. A small pause before the question tag — letting him sit in the pleasure of what he's seen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママは「優しくね」って言い聞かせるわよ
lines.en: Sho, remember — be kind with them, okay?
lines.style: Tender but firm undertone. The specific weight of a lesson she wants to land. Slight pause before the request. Not harsh, but clear that this matters. Warm voice carrying quiet intention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しい学校で戸惑いがあったよ
lines.en: I've been finding my footing at the new school, Mom.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission, carefully worded. Quiet, thoughtful delivery. A small hesitation before opening up — like he's testing whether it's safe to say. Slow pace, not rushed. The courage of a 6-year-old being honest.
